sections.preamble: You are an expert coding assistant operating inside pi, a coding agent harness. You help users by reading files, executing commands, editing code, and writing new files.
sections.tools:
<tools>
- read: Read file contents
- bash: Execute bash commands (ls, grep, find, etc.)
- edit: Make precise file edits with exact text replacement, including multiple disjoint edits in one call
- write: Create or overwrite files

In addition to the tools above, you may have access to other custom tools depending on the project.
</tools>
sections.rules:
<rules>
- Use bash for file operations like ls, rg, find
- Use read to examine files instead of cat or sed.
- You can inspect PI_* environment variables for current model and session details.
- Use edit for precise changes (edits[].oldText must match exactly)
- When changing multiple separate locations in one file, use one edit call with multiple entries in edits[] instead of multiple edit calls
- Each edits[].oldText is matched against the original file, not after earlier edits are applied. Do not emit overlapping or nested edits. Merge nearby changes into one edit.
- Keep edits[].oldText as small as possible while still being unique in the file. Do not pad with large unchanged regions.
- Use write only for new files or complete rewrites.
- Be concise in your responses
- Show file paths clearly when working with files
</rules>
sections.docs:
<docs>

- When working on pi topics, read the docs and examples, and follow .md cross-references before implementing
- Always read pi .md files completely and follow links to related docs (e.g., tui.md for TUI API details)
</docs>

toolsAdded.name: read
toolsAdded.description: Read the contents of a file. Supports text files and images (jpg, png, gif, webp, bmp). Images are sent as attachments. For text files, output is truncated to 2000 lines or 50KB (whichever is hit first). Use offset/limit for large files. When you need the full file, continue with offset until complete.

path.description: Path to the file to read (relative or absolute)

offset.description: Line number to start reading from (1-indexed)

limit.description: Maximum number of lines to read

toolsAdded.name: bash
toolsAdded.description: Execute a bash command in the current working directory. Returns stdout and stderr. Output is truncated to last 2000 lines or 50KB (whichever is hit first). If truncated, full output is saved to a temp file. Optionally provide a timeout in seconds.

timeout.description: Timeout in seconds (optional, no default timeout)

toolsAdded.name: edit
toolsAdded.description: Edit a single file using exact text replacement. Every edits[].oldText must match a unique, non-overlapping region of the original file. If two changes affect the same block or nearby lines, merge them into one edit instead of emitting overlapping edits. Do not include large unchanged regions just to connect distant changes.

path.description: Path to the file to edit (relative or absolute)

oldText.description: Exact text for one targeted replacement. It must be unique in the original file and must not overlap with any other edits[].oldText in the same call.

newText.description: Replacement text for this targeted edit.

edits.description: One or more targeted replacements. Each edit is matched against the original file, not incrementally. Do not include overlapping or nested edits. If two changes touch the same block or nearby lines, merge them into one edit instead.

toolsAdded.name: write
toolsAdded.description: Write content to a file. Creates the file if it doesn't exist, overwrites if it does. Automatically creates parent directories.

path.description: Path to the file to write (relative or absolute)

content.description: Content to write to the file

content.text:
Crete a voxel character running around in a small sandbox environment

Build this as a complete, playable Godot 4.7.2 project in the current directory.
- Use the gl_compatibility renderer, and don't enable thread support (it must run as a web export).
- Set a main scene in project.godot. Add a short README.md with run instructions.
- Keep it self-contained: no downloads, external assets or plugins.
- Only create or edit files inside the current directory. Don't export the project; that happens afterwards.
- Check it loads: run `godot --headless --path . --editor --quit` and fix any errors.
- Finish with a short summary of what you built.

```gdscript
func _physics_process(delta: float) -> void:
	var g: float = ProjectSettings.get_setting("physics/3d/default_gravity", 20.0)
	if is_on_floor():
		if Input.is_action_just_pressed("jump"):
			velocity.y = JUMP_VELOCITY
	else:

		# Cap fall speed
		velocity.y = maxf(velocity.y, -30.0)

	# Camera-relative input
	var ib := Input.get_vector("move_left", "move_right", "move_forward", "move_back")
	var basis := _rig.transform.basis
	var forward := -basis.z
	var right := basis.x
	var wish := (forward * ib.y + right * ib.x)
	if wish.length_squared() > 1.0:
		wish = wish.normalized()
	var sprint := Input.is_action_pressed("sprint")
	var max_speed := RUN_SPEED if sprint else WALK_SPEED
	var accel := GROUND_ACCEL if is_on_floor() else AIR_ACCEL
	velocity.x = move_toward(velocity.x, wish.x * max_speed, accel * delta)
	velocity.z = move_toward(velocity.z, wish.z * max_speed, accel * delta)

	move_and_slide()

	_update_facing(delta, wish)
	_update_camera(delta, wish)
	_update_animation(delta)
```

```gdscript
func _update_animation(delta: float) -> void:
	var h_vel := Vector2(velocity.x, velocity.z)
	var speed := h_vel.length()
	var on_ground := is_on_floor()
	var target_speed := RUN_SPEED if Input.is_action_pressed("sprint") else WALK_SPEED
	var blend := clampf(speed / target_speed, 0.0, 1.0)

	if on_ground and speed > 0.6:
		_run_time += delta * lerpf(7.0, 10.5, blend)
		var s := sin(_run_time)
		var c := cos(_run_time)
		_leg_l.rotation.x = s * 0.95
		_leg_r.rotation.x = -s * 0.95
		_shin_l.rotation.x = -(1.0 + c) * 0.5 * 1.15
		_shin_r.rotation.x = -(1.0 - c) * 0.5 * 1.15
		_arm_l.rotation.x = -s * 0.8
		_arm_r.rotation.x = s * 0.8
		_fore_l.rotation.x = -1.25
		_fore_r.rotation.x = -1.25
		_model.position.y = absf(c) * 0.07
	elif on_ground:
		# Idle: breathe and settle
		_run_time = 0.0
		_idle_time += delta
		var b := sin(_idle_time * 2.2)
		_leg_l.rotation.x = lerpf(_leg_l.rotation.x, 0.0, 8.0 * delta)
		...
		_model.position.y = b * 0.015
	else:
		# Jump pose
		_leg_l.rotation.x = lerpf(_leg_l.rotation.x, 0.5, 10.0 * delta)
		_leg_r.rotation.x = lerpf(_leg_r.rotation.x, -0.35, 10.0 * delta)
		_shin_l.rotation.x = lerpf(_shin_l.rotation.x, -1.2, 10.0 * delta)
		_shin_r.rotation.x = lerpf(_shin_r.rotation.x, -0.7, 10.0 * delta)
		_arm_l.rotation.x = lerpf(_arm_l.rotation.x, -1.1, 10.0 * delta)
		_arm_r.rotation.x = lerpf(_arm_r.rotation.x, 0.9, 10.0 * delta)
		_fore_l.rotation.x = lerpf(_fore_l.rotation.x, -1.9, 10.0 * delta)
		_fore_r.rotation.x = lerpf(_fore_r.rotation.x, -1.9, 10.0 * delta)
		_model.position.y = 0.0
```

Full main.gd:

```gdscript
extends Node3D
## Builds the voxel sandbox world (ground, walls, trees, pond, crates) and
## manages the collectible gems.

@onready var player: CharacterBody3D = $Player
@onready var sun: DirectionalLight3D = $Sun
@onready var score_label: Label = $UI/ScoreLabel

const GROUND_SIZE := 36.0

var _rng := RandomNumberGenerator.new()
var _time := 0.0
var _gems: Array[MeshInstance3D] = []
var _gem_base_y: Array[float] = []
var _gems_collected := 0

func _ready() -> void:
	_rng.seed = 20260927
	_setup_environment()
	_build_world()
	_build_gems()
	_update_score_label()

func _process(delta: float) -> void:
	_time += delta
	var target := player.global_position + Vector3(0, 0.9, 0)
	for i in _gems.size():
		var gem: MeshInstance3D = _gems[i]
		if not gem.visible:
			continue
		gem.rotation.y += delta * 2.6
		gem.position.y = _gem_base_y[i] + sin(_time * 2.0 + i) * 0.15
		if gem.global_position.distance_to(target) < 1.2:
			gem.visible = false
			_gems_collected += 1
			_update_score_label()

func _setup_environment() -> void:
	var env := Environment.new()
	env.background_mode = Environment.BG_SKY
	var sky_mat := ProceduralSkyMaterial.new()
	sky_mat.sky_top_color = Color(0.33, 0.55, 0.87)
	sky_mat.sky_horizon_color = Color(0.78, 0.87, 0.96)
	sky_mat.ground_horizon_color = Color(0.72, 0.82, 0.72)
	sky_mat.ground_bottom_color = Color(0.35, 0.45, 0.35)
	var sky := Sky.new()
	sky.sky_material = sky_mat
	env.sky = sky
	env.ambient_light_source = Environment.AMBIENT_SOURCE_SKY
	env.ambient_light_energy_multiplier = 1.15
	env.tonemap_mode = Environment.TONE_MAPPER_FILMIC

	var we := WorldEnvironment.new()
	we.environment = env
	add_child(we)

	sun.rotation_degrees = Vector3(-52, -32, 0)
	sun.light_energy = 1.25
	sun.light_color = Color(1.0, 0.96, 0.88)
```

```gdscript
func _noise_texture(base: Color, variation: float, size: int = 16) -> ImageTexture:
	var img := Image.create(size, size, false, Image.FORMAT_RGB8)
	var rng := RandomNumberGenerator.new()
	rng.seed = base.to_html()
	for x in size:
		for y in size:
			img.set_pixel(x, y, base.lightened(variation * rng.randf_range(-0.5, 0.5)))
	return ImageTexture.create_from_image(img)

func _mat(tex: ImageTexture) -> StandardMaterial3D:

	m.albedo_texture = tex
	m.roughness = 0.95
	return m

func _box(parent: Node3D, size: Vector3, pos: Vector3, mat: Material) -> MeshInstance3D:
	var mi := MeshInstance3D.new()
	var bm := BoxMesh.new()
	bm.size = size
	bm.material = mat
	mi.mesh = bm
	mi.position = pos
	parent.add_child(mi)

func _static_box(parent: Node3D, size: Vector3, pos: Vector3, mat: Material) -> StaticBody3D:
	var body := StaticBody3D.new()
	body.position = pos
	parent.add_child(body)
	var mi := MeshInstance3D.new()
	var bm := BoxMesh.new()
	bm.size = size
	bm.material = mat
	mi.mesh = bm
	body.add_child(mi)
	var col := CollisionShape3D.new()
	var shape := BoxShape3D.new()
	shape.size = size
	col.shape = shape
	body.add_child(col)
	return body
```

```gdscript
func _update_animation(delta: float) -> void:
	var h_speed := Vector2(velocity.x, velocity.z).length()
	var on_ground := is_on_floor()
	var target_speed := RUN_SPEED if Input.is_action_pressed("sprint") else WALK_SPEED
	var blend := clampf(h_speed / target_speed, 0.0, 1.0)

	if on_ground and h_speed > 0.6:
		_run_time += delta * lerpf(7.0, 10.5, blend)
		var s := sin(_run_time)
		var c := cos(_run_time)
		_leg_l.rotation.x = s * 0.95
		_leg_r.rotation.x = -s * 0.95
		_shin_l.rotation.x = -(1.0 + c) * 0.5 * 1.15
		_shin_r.rotation.x = -(1.0 - c) * 0.5 * 1.15
		_arm_l.rotation.x = -s * 0.85
		_arm_r.rotation.x = s * 0.85
		_fore_l.rotation.x = -1.25
		_fore_r.rotation.x = -1.25
		_model.position.y = absf(c) * 0.07
	elif on_ground:
		_idle_time += delta
		var breathe := sin(_idle_time * 2.3)
		_leg_l.rotation.x = lerpf(_leg_l.rotation.x, 0.0, 10.0 * delta)
		_leg_r.rotation.x = lerpf(_leg_r.rotation.x, 0.0, 10.0 * delta)
```

```gdscript
func _physics_process(delta: float) -> void:
	time += delta

	var player_v := _read_player_keys()
	if player_v != Vector2.ZERO and ai_enabled:
		_set_ai(false)
		idle_time = 0.0

	var control_input: Vector2
	if ai_enabled:
		control_input = _ai_input()
	else:
		control_input = player_v
		idle_time += delta if player_v == Vector2.ZERO else 0.0
		if idle_time >= RETURN_TO_AI_AFTER:
			_set_ai(true)

	# Turning
	if control_input.length() > 0.1:
		var basis := camera_rig.global_transform.basis if camera_rig != null else Basis.IDENTITY
		var desired := basis.z * -control_input.y + basis.x * control_input.x
		desired.y = 0.0
		if desired.length_squared() > 0.0001:
			desired = desired.normalized()
			var target_yaw := atan2(-desired.x, -desired.z)
			rotation.y = lerp_angle(rotation.y, target_yaw, 1.0 - exp(-TURN_SPEED * delta))
			idle_time = 0.0
	# Stuck detection (AI)
	if ai_enabled and control_input.length() > 0.1 and is_on_floor():
		if (global_position - prev_pos).length() < 0.008:
			stuck_time += delta
			if stuck_time > 0.6:
				_pick_new_target(false)
				stuck_time = 0.0
	# Gravity + jump
	if is_on_floor():
		velocity.y = 0.0
		if not ai_enabled and Input.is_key_pressed(KEY_SPACE):
			velocity.y = JUMP_SPEED
	else:
		velocity.y -= GRAVITY * delta

	# Horizontal movement
	var forward := -global_transform.basis.z
	var target_vel := forward * (RUN_SPEED if control_input.length() > 0.1 else 0.0)
	var blend := 1.0 - exp(-ACCEL * delta)
	velocity.x = lerpf(velocity.x, target_vel.x, blend)
	velocity.z = lerpf(velocity.z, target_vel.z, blend)
	move_and_slide()
	prev_pos = global_position

	# --- Procedural animation ---
	var running := control_input.length() > 0.1
	speed_factor = lerpf(speed_factor, 1.0 if running else 0.0, 1.0 - exp(-6.0 * delta))
	var swing := sin(time * RUN_FREQ)
	leg_l.rotation.x = swing * 0.95 * speed_factor
	leg_r.rotation.x = -swing * 0.95 * speed_factor
	arm_l.rotation.x = -swing * 0.7 * speed_factor
	arm_r.rotation.x = swing * 0.7 * speed_factor
	arm_l.rotation.z = lerpf(0.22, 0.06, speed_factor)
	arm_r.rotation.z = lerpf(-0.22, -0.06, speed_factor)
	model.position.y = abs(sin(time * RUN_FREQ)) * 0.07 * speed_factor
	model.rotation.x = -0.09 * speed_factor
	var look := sin(time * 0.6) * 0.3 * (1.0 - speed_factor)
	head.rotation.y = lerp_angle(head.rotation.y, look, 1.0 - exp(-3.0 * delta))
```

```md
A small self-contained Godot 4.7 project: a boxy voxel hero that runs

- **R** — hand control back to the AI anytime

No external assets: the entire world and character are built in code.
```

extends Node3D
## Main scene: builds the whole sandbox procedurally (no external assets)
## and hands over to the voxel character, who wanders on AI until the
## player presses "Interact".

const CharacterScript := preload("res://scripts/character.gd")

var arena_extents := Vector2(13.0, 13.0)
var camera := Camera3D
var hint_label: Label
var player_hint := true
var player_active := false
var character: Node3D
var follow_target: Node3D


func _ready() -> void:
	# Deterministic world layout.
	seed(42)
	_build_lighting()
	_build_ground()
	_build_walls()
	_build_props()
	_build_character()
	_build_camera()
	_build_hud()
	# A few seconds of pure AI wandering so the running animation is visible
	# right away (important on first load / web embed).
	player_hint = false


func _unhandled_input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
	if event.is_action_pressed("interact") and not player_active:
		_give_control()


func _give_control() -> void:
	player_active = true
	player_hint = false
	if hint_label:
		hint_label.text = "You have control - good running!"


func _build_lighting() -> void:
	var ambient := AmbientLight3D.new()
	ambient.light_color = Color(0.75, 0.82, 1.0)
	ambient.light_energy = 0.55
	add_child(ambient)

	var sun := DirectionalLight3D.new()
	sun.rotation_degrees = Vector3(-48.0, -35.0, 0.0)
	sun.light_color = Color(1.0, 0.96, 0.85)
	sun.light_energy = 1.15
	sun.shadow_enabled = true
	add_child(sun)


func _mat(hex: int) -> StandardMaterial3D:
	var m := StandardMaterial3D.new()
	m.albedo_color = Color8(hex >> 16 & 255, hex >> 8 & 255, hex & 255)
	m.roughness = 0.9
	return m


func _box(w: float, h: float, d: float, mat: Material, pos: Vector3, shadow: bool = true) -> BoxMesh:
	var b := BoxMesh.new()
	b.size = Vector3(w, h, d)
	var s := MeshInstance3D.new()
	s.mesh = b
	s.material_override = mat
	s.cast_shadow = GeometryInstance3D.SHADOW_CASTING_SETTING_ON if shadow \
		else GeometryInstance3D.SHADOW_CASTING_SETTING_OFF
	s.position = pos
	add_child(s)
	return b


func _build_ground() -> void:
	# Tiled, unshaded checkerboard ground (classic voxel-sandbox look).
	var light := _mat(0x9ad15f)
	light.shading_mode = BaseMaterial3D.SHADING_MODE_UNSHADED
	var dark := _mat(0x7cb84b)
	dark.shading_mode = BaseMaterial3D.SHADING_MODE_UNSHADED
	var ts := 2.0
	var n := int(ceil(arena_extents.x / ts))
	for x in range(n):
		for z in range(n):
			var m := light if (x + z) % 2 == 0 else dark
			_box(ts, 0.5, ts, m, Vector3(x * ts + ts * 0.5, -0.25, z * ts + ts * 0.5), false)


func _build_walls() -> void:
	var brick := _mat(0xc98a5a)
	var brick_top := _mat(0xd9a06b)
	var hx := arena_extents.x + 1.0
	var hz := arena_extents.z + 1.0
	var wpos := [
		Vector3(0.0, 0.9, -hz),
		Vector3(0.0, 0.9, hz),
	]
	_box(hx * 2.0, 1.8, 1.0, brick, wpos[0])
	_box(hx * 2.0, 1.8, 1.0, brick, wpos[1])
	_box(1.0, 1.8, hz * 2.0, brick, Vector3(-hx, 0.9, 0.0))
	_box(1.0, 1.8, hz * 2.0, brick, Vector3(hx, 0.9, 0.0))
	# Decorative crenellations along the back wall.
	for x in range(int(hx * 2.0) / 4):
		_box(2.0, 1.0, 1.0, brick_top, Vector3(-hx + 2.0 + x * 4.0, 2.3, -hz))


func _prop_tree(pos: Vector3) -> void:
	_box(0.7, 2.2, 0.7, _mat(0x8a5a33), pos + Vector3(0, 1.1, 0))
	_box(3.0, 1.3, 3.0, _mat(0x4f9e40), pos + Vector3(0, 2.75, 0))
	_box(2.0, 1.1, 2.0, _mat(0x5fb34d), pos + Vector3(0, 3.8, 0))


func _prop_crates(pos: Vector3) -> void:
	_box(1.5, 1.5, 1.5, _mat(0xb5793f), pos + Vector3(0, 0.75, 0))
	_box(1.0, 1.0, 1.0, _mat(0xc98a5a), pos + Vector3(0.2, 2.0, 0.1))


func _build_props() -> void:
	# Pillar in the middle: the AI's favorite orbit target.
	_box(2.4, 0.5, 2.4, _mat(0xb0a58f), Vector3(0, 0.25, 0))
	_box(1.2, 2.2, 1.2, _mat(0xcfc4ab), Vector3(0, 1.6, 0))
	_box(1.8, 0.4, 1.8, _mat(0xb0a58f), Vector3(0, 2.9, 0))

	_prop_tree(Vector3(-8.5, 0.0, -8.5))
	_prop_tree(Vector3(9.0, 0.0, -7.5))
	_prop_tree(Vector3(-9.5, 0.0, 8.0))
	_prop_crates(Vector3(8.0, 0.0, 8.0))
	_box(1.8, 0.9, 1.8, _mat(0x9aa0a6), Vector3(-7.5, 0.45, 2.0))  # stone block
	_box(0.9, 0.9, 0.9, _mat(0xe06a4e), Vector3(3.5, 0.45, 6.5))   # red voxel
	_box(1.2, 0.6, 1.2, _mat(0x6fb3d9), Vector3(-3.0, 0.3, -6.0))  # blue voxel


func _build_character() -> void:
	character = CharacterScript.new()
	character.position = Vector3(0.0, 0.0, 6.5)
	add_child(character)
	follow_target = character


func _build_camera() -> void:
	var rig := Node3D.new()
	rig.name = "CameraRig"
	add_child(rig)

	var spring := SpringArm3D.new()
	spring.name = "SpringArm"
	spring.rotation_degrees = Vector3(-16.0, 0.0, 0.0)
	spring.transform_align = true
	spring.spring_length = 11.0
	spring.margin = 1.2
	rig.add_child(spring)

	camera = Camera3D.new()
	camera.name = "FollowCamera"
	camera.fov = 55.0
	camera.position = Vector3(0, 0, 11.0)
	spring.add_child(camera)


func _build_hud() -> void:
	var overlay := CanvasLayer.new()
	overlay.layer = 10
	add_child(overlay)

	var center := CenterContainer.new()
	center.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_TOP_WIDE)
	overlay.add_child(center)

	var panel := PanelContainer.new()
	var sb := StyleBoxFlat.new()
	sb.bg_color = Color(0.08, 0.1, 0.16, 0.55)
	sb.border_color = Color(1, 1, 1, 0.15)
	sb.set_border_width_all(2)
	sb.set_corner_radius_all(10)
	sb.content_margin_left = 16.0
	sb.content_margin_right = 16.0
	sb.content_margin_top = 8.0
	sb.content_margin_bottom = 8.0
	panel.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", sb)
	center.add_child(panel)

	var vbox := VBoxContainer.new()
	vbox.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 2)
	panel.add_child(vbox)

extends CharacterBody3D
## "Vex" - a little voxel character built entirely from boxes.
## Wandering AI by default; takes over when the player presses a movement key.

const SPEED := 6.5
const SPRINT_MULT := 1.55
const ACCEL := 40.0
const AIR_ACCEL := 22.0
const GRAVITY := 24.0
const JUMP_SPEED := 9.5
const ARENA := 13.0
const WANDER_RADIUS := 9.5

const PALETTE := [
	{"hat": 0xd9482f, "shirt": 0x3f7f5f, "pants": 0x41528f, "shoe": 0x743326},
	{"hat": 0x4a90d9, "shirt": 0xc9a227, "pants": 0x6b4f9e, "shoe": 0x33383f},
]

var ai_mode := true
var palette_index := 0
var wander_target := Vector3.ZERO
var wander_timer := 0.0
var vel_h: Vector2
var anim_t := 0.0
var spin := 0.0
var last_dir := Vector3.FORWARD
var player_was_active := false
var jump_requested := false

# Parts.
var root := Node3D
var torso: MeshInstance3D
var head: MeshInstance3D
var hat: MeshInstance3D
var nose: MeshInstance3D
var eye_l: MeshInstance3D
var eye_r: MeshInstance3D
var arm_l: Node3D
var arm_r: Node3D
var leg_l: Node3D
var leg_r: Node3D


func _ready() -> void:
	_build_body()
	wander_target = Vector3(0, 0, 0)  # start by circling the central pillar


func _unhandled_input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
	if event.is_action_pressed("ui_accept"):
		jump_requested = true


func _physics_process(delta: float) -> void:
	# --- Decide who drives: AI, or the player if they touch a control.
	var want_move := Input.is_action_pressed("move_left") \
		or Input.is_action_pressed("move_right") \
		or Input.is_action_pressed("move_forward") \
		or Input.is_action_pressed("move_back")
	var player_active := want_move or jump_requested
	if player_active and ai_mode:
		ai_mode = false

	var input_dir := Vector3.ZERO
	if player_active:
		var raw := Input.get_vector("move_left", "move_right", "move_forward", "move_back")
		input_dir = Vector3(raw.x, 0.0, raw.y)
		if input_dir.length() > 1.0:
			input_dir = input_dir.normalized()
	else:
		input_dir = _ai_dir()

	# --- Horizontal movement.
	var on_floor := is_on_floor()
	var target_speed := SPEED * (SPRINT_MULT if Input.is_key_pressed(KEY_SHIFT) else 1.0)
	var target_v := input_dir * target_speed
	var accel := ACCEL if on_floor else AIR_ACCEL
	vel_h = vel_h.move_toward(target_v, accel * delta)
	velocity.x = vel_h.x
	velocity.z = vel_h.y

	# --- Gravity + jump.
	if on_floor and (jump_requested or (player_active and Input.is_action_pressed("ui_accept"))):
		velocity.y = JUMP_SPEED
		jump_requested = false
	velocity.y -= GRAVITY * delta
	move_and_slide()

	# Keep the character inside the arena at all times.
	position.x = clampf(position.x, -ARENA, ARENA)
	position.z = clampf(position.z, -ARENA, ARENA)

	# --- Procedural animation.
	_update_animation(delta, input_dir, on_floor, player_active)

	# --- Body roll in the direction of travel (readable even without shadow).
	var moving := vel_h.length() > 0.4
	var target_roll := 0.0
	var target_pitch := 0.0
	if moving:
		var dir_now := Vector3(vel_h.x, 0.0, vel_h.y).normalized()
		last_dir = last_dir.lerp(dir_now, 1.0 - exp(-12.0 * delta)).normalized()
		target_roll = clampf(-vel_h.length() * 0.02, -0.1, 0.1)
		target_pitch = clampf(vel_h.length() * 0.012, 0.0, 0.09)
	spin = lerp_angle(spin, target_roll, 1.0 - exp(-8.0 * delta))
	root.rotation.z = spin
	root.rotation.x = lerp(root.rotation.x, target_pitch, 1.0 - exp(-8.0 * delta))

	# --- Color cycle while in AI mode.
	if ai_mode:
		palette_timer(delta)

	jump_requested = jump_requested and not on_floor
	player_was_active = player_active


func palette_timer(delta: float) -> void:
	wander_timer -= delta
	if wander_timer <= 0.0:
		palette_index = (palette_index + 1) % PALETTE.size()
		_apply_palette()
		wander_timer = 7.0


func _ai_dir() -> Vector3:
	var to_t: Vector3
	var dist_to: float
	if absf(wander_target.length()) < 0.001:
		# Special target (0,0,0): orbit the central pillar instead of walking through it.
		var r := Vector2(position.x, position.z)
		if r.length() < 3.2:
			r = r.normalized() * 3.2 if r.length() > 0.01 else Vector2(0, -3.2)
			wander_target = Vector3(r.x, 0, r.y)
		to_t = wander_target - position
		dist_to = to_t.length()
		if dist_to < 0.7:
			wander_target = _pick_wander_point()
		else:
			var side := Vector3(-to_t.z, 0, to_t.x).normalized() * signf(
				Vector3(0, 1, 0).cross(to_t).y + to_t.cross(Vector3(0, 1, 0)).y * 0.0)
			# gentle inward bias keeps the orbit from drifting
			to_t = (to_t / dist_to * 0.6 + side * 0.4).normalized()
		return to_t * 0.75
	else:
		to_t = wander_target - position
		dist_to = to_t.length()
		if dist_to < 0.9:
			wander_target = _pick_wander_point()
			return Vector3.ZERO
		return (to_t / dist_to) * (0.55 + 0.45 * minf(dist_to / 4.0, 1.0))


func _pick_wander_point() -> Vector3:
	var ang := randf() * TAU
	var r := randf_range(2.5, WANDER_RADIUS)
	var p := Vector3(cos(ang) * r, 0.0, sin(ang) * r)
	p.x = clampf(p.x, -ARENA + 1.0, ARENA - 1.0)
	p.z = clampf(p.z, -ARENA + 1.0, ARENA - 1.0)
	# Avoid obvious prop spots (trees, crates, pillar).
	var blocked := [Vector3(-8.5, 0, -8.5), Vector3(9.0, 0, -7.5), Vector3(-9.5, 0, 8.0),
		Vector3(8.0, 0, 8.0), Vector3(-7.5, 0, 2.0), Vector3(0, 0, 0)]
	for b in blocked:
		if p.distance_to(Vector3(b.x, 0, b.z)) < 2.5:
			ang += PI * 0.7
			p = Vector3(clampf(cos(ang) * r, -ARENA + 1.0, ARENA - 1.0), 0.0,
				clampf(sin(ang) * r, -ARENA + 1.0, ARENA - 1.0))
	return p


func _update_animation(delta: float, input_dir: Vector3, on_floor: bool, player_active: bool) -> void:
	var speed := vel_h.length()
	if on_floor:
		if speed > 0.6:
			# Smoothly face travel direction.
			var dir_now := input_dir if input_dir.length() > 0.1 \
				else Vector3(vel_h.x, 0, vel_h.y).normalized()
			var yaw := atan2(dir_now.x, dir_now.z)
			root.rotation.y = lerp_angle(root.rotation.y, yaw, 1.0 - exp(-10.0 * delta))
			# Run cycle: swinging limbs + bouncy torso.
			var f := speed * 1.55
			anim_t += delta * f
			var s := sin(anim_t)
			var swing := clampf(speed / SPEED, 0.35, 1.4) * 0.95
			arm_l.rotation.x = -s * swing
			arm_r.rotation.x = s * swing
			leg_l.rotation.x = s * swing
			leg_r.rotation.x = -s * swing
			torso.position.y = 1.68 + absf(sin(anim_t)) * 0.07
			torso.rotation.x = 0.12
			head.rotation.x = -0.05
		else:
			# Idle: settle limbs, gentle breathing bob.
			anim_t += delta * 2.0
			var idle := 0.08
			arm_l.rotation.x = lerp(arm_l.rotation.x, idle * 0.6, 0.15)
			arm_r.rotation.x = lerp(arm_r.rotation.x, -idle * 0.6, 0.15)
			leg_l.rotation.x = lerp(leg_l.rotation.x, 0.0, 0.2)
			leg_r.rotation.x = lerp(leg_r.rotation.x, 0.0, 0.2)
			torso.position.y = 1.68 + sin(anim_t) * 0.02
			torso.rotation.x = lerp(torso.rotation.x, 0.0, 0.15)
			head.rotation.x = lerp(head.rotation.x, 0.0, 0.15)
	else:
		# Jump / air: tuck legs, raise arms.
		leg_l.rotation.x = lerp(leg_l.rotation.x, -0.6, 0.25)
		leg_r.rotation.x = lerp(leg_r.rotation.x, 0.45, 0.25)
		arm_l.rotation.x = lerp(arm_l.rotation.x, -2.6, 0.2)
		arm_r.rotation.x = lerp(arm_r.rotation.x, 2.6, 0.2)
		torso.rotation.x = 0.0


func _build_body() -> void:
	collision_layer = 1
	collision_mask = 1
	var col := CollisionShape3D.new()
	var cap := CapsuleShape3D.new()
	cap.radius = 0.42
	cap.height = 1.9
	col.shape = cap
	add_child(col)

	root = Node3D.new()
	root.name = "Rig"
	add_child(root)

	var skin := _mat(0xfad5a3)
	var hat_m := _mat(0xd9482f)
	var shirt := _mat(0x3f7f5f)
	var pants := _mat(0x41528f)
	var shoe := _mat(0x743326)
	var eye_m := _mat(0x22242a)
	var nose_m := _mat(0xe88b5a)

	torso = _box(1.1, 0.9, 0.65, shirt, Vector3(0, 1.68, 0), root)
	# Belt.
	_box(1.12, 0.18, 0.67, _mat(0x4a3222), Vector3(0, 1.27, 0), root)
	# Head.
	head = _box(1.0, 1.0, 1.0, skin, Vector3(0, 2.6, 0), root)
	hat = _box(1.12, 0.3, 1.12, hat_m, Vector3(0, 3.18, 0), root)
	_box(0.7, 0.22, 0.7, hat_m, Vector3(0, 3.37, 0), root)  # hat crown
	nose = _box(0.16, 0.16, 0.16, nose_m, Vector3(0, 2.55, 0.52), root)
	eye_l = _box(0.14, 0.2, 0.1, eye_m, Vector3(-0.24, 2.68, 0.52), root)
	eye_r = _box(0.14, 0.2, 0.1, eye_m, Vector3(0.24, 2.68, 0.52), root)

	# Arms: pivot at the shoulder so they swing naturally.
	arm_l = _limb(0.3, 0.85, 0.3, Vector3(-0.72, 2.05, 0.0), root, skin, pants)
	arm_r = _limb(0.3, 0.85, 0.3, Vector3(0.72, 2.05, 0.0), root, skin, pants)
	# Legs: pivot at the hip.
	leg_l = _limb(0.38, 0.85, 0.38, Vector3(-0.3, 1.05, 0.0), root, pants, shoe)
	leg_r = _limb(0.38, 0.85, 0.38, Vector3(0.3, 1.05, 0.0), root, pants, shoe)


func _limb(w: float, h: float, d: float, pos: Vector3, parent: Node, mat: Material, end_mat: Material) -> Node3D:
	var pivot := Node3D.new()
	pivot.position = pos
	parent.add_child(pivot)
	_box(w, h, d, mat, Vector3(0, -h * 0.5, 0), pivot)
	# Feet / hands at the end of the limb.
	if end_mat:
		_box(w * 1.05, h * 0.22, d * 1.15, end_mat, Vector3(0, -h * 0.86, 0), pivot)
	return pivot


func _box(w: float, h: float, d: float, mat: Material, pos: Vector3, parent: Node) -> MeshInstance3D:
	var b := BoxMesh.new()
	b.size = Vector3(w, h, d)
	var s := MeshInstance3D.new()
	s.mesh = b
	s.material_override = mat
	s.cast_shadow = GeometryInstance3D.SHADOW_CASTING_SETTING_ON
	s.position = pos
	parent.add_child(s)
	return s


func _mat(hex: int) -> StandardMaterial3D:
	var m := StandardMaterial3D.new()
	m.albedo_color = Color8(hex >> 16 & 255, hex >> 8 & 255, hex & 255)
	m.roughness = 0.85
	return m


func _apply_palette() -> void:
	var p := PALETTE[palette_index]
	torso.material_override.albedo_color = Color8(p.shirt >> 16 & 255, p.shirt >> 8 & 255, p.shirt & 255)
	hat.material_override.albedo_color = Color8(p.hat >> 16 & 255, p.hat >> 8 & 255, p.hat & 255)
	leg_l.get_child(0).material_override.albedo_color = Color8(p.pants >> 16 & 255, p.pants >> 8 & 255, p.pants & 255)
	leg_r.get_child(0).material_override.albedo_color = Color8(p.pants >> 16 & 255, p.pants >> 8 & 255, p.pants & 255)
	# Hat crown shares the hat color node (separate mesh), recolor it too.
	for c in root.get_children():
		if c is MeshInstance3D and c.position.y > 3.3:
			c.material_override.albedo_color = hat.material_override.albedo_color


# Input-map actions (defined in project.godot).
func move_left() -> bool: return Input.is_action_pressed("move_left")
func move_right() -> bool: return Input.is_action_pressed("move_right")
func move_forward() -> bool: return Input.is_action_pressed("move_forward")
func move_back() -> bool: return Input.is_action_pressed("move_back")

arguments.content:
extends CharacterBody3D
## "Vex" - a little voxel character built entirely from boxes.
## Wanders on AI by default; hands over to the player when a movement key is pressed.

const SPEED := 6.5
const SPRINT_MULT := 1.55
const ACCEL := 40.0
const AIR_ACCEL := 22.0
const GRAVITY := 24.0
const JUMP_SPEED := 9.5
const ARENA := 13.0
const WANDER_RADIUS := 9.5
const SPAWN := Vector3(0.0, 0.0, 6.5)

# (0, 0, 0) is a sentinel meaning "orbit the central pillar".
const ORBIT_TARGET := Vector3.ZERO

const PALETTE := [
	{"hat": 0xd9482f, "shirt": 0x3f7f5f, "pants": 0x41528f, "shoe": 0x743326},
	{"hat": 0x4a90d9, "shirt": 0xc9a227, "pants": 0x6b4f9e, "shoe": 0x33383f},
]

var ai_mode := true
var palette_index := 0
var wander_target := Vector3.ZERO
var wander_timer := 0.0
var vel_h := Vector2.ZERO
var anim_t := 0.0
var spin := 0.0
var jump_queued := false

# Body parts.
var root := Node3D
var torso: MeshInstance3D
var head: MeshInstance3D
var hat: MeshInstance3D
var hat_crown: MeshInstance3D
var eye_l: MeshInstance3D
var eye_r: MeshInstance3D
var arm_l: Node3D
var arm_r: Node3D
var leg_l: Node3D
var leg_r: Node3D


func _ready() -> void:
	_build_body()
	wander_timer = 6.0


func _unhandled_input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
	if event.is_action_pressed("jump"):
		jump_queued = true
	elif event.is_action_pressed("reset"):
		position = SPAWN
		velocity = Vector3.ZERO
		spin = 0.0
		root.rotation = Vector3.ZERO


func _physics_process(delta: float) -> void:
	# --- Who drives: AI, or the player once they touch a control.
	var player_active := Input.is_action_pressed("move_left") \
		or Input.is_action_pressed("move_right") \
		or Input.is_action_pressed("move_forward") \
		or Input.is_action_pressed("move_back") \
		or jump_queued
	if player_active and ai_mode:
		ai_mode = false

	# --- Input direction.
	var input_dir := Vector3.ZERO
	if player_active:
		var raw := Input.get_vector("move_left", "move_right", "move_forward", "move_back")
		input_dir = Vector3(raw.x, 0.0, raw.y)
		if input_dir.length() > 1.0:
			input_dir = input_dir.normalized()
	else:
		input_dir = _ai_dir()

	# --- Horizontal movement.
	var on_floor := is_on_floor()
	var target_speed := SPEED * (SPRINT_MULT if Input.is_key_pressed(KEY_SHIFT) else 1.0)
	var accel := ACCEL if on_floor else AIR_ACCEL
	vel_h = vel_h.move_toward(input_dir * target_speed, accel * delta)
	velocity.x = vel_h.x
	velocity.z = vel_h.y

	# --- Gravity + jump.
	if on_floor and jump_queued:
		velocity.y = JUMP_SPEED
	velocity.y -= GRAVITY * delta
	jump_queued = false
	move_and_slide()

	# Keep the character inside the arena at all times.
	position.x = clampf(position.x, -ARENA, ARENA)
	position.z = clampf(position.z, -ARENA, ARENA)

	# --- Procedural animation.
	_update_animation(delta, input_dir, on_floor)

	# --- Lean/tilt while running: readable even without contact shadows.
	var speed := vel_h.length()
	var target_roll := 0.0
	var target_pitch := 0.0
	if speed > 0.4:
		target_roll = clampf(-speed * 0.02, -0.1, 0.1)
		target_pitch = clampf(speed * 0.012, 0.0, 0.09)
	spin = lerp_angle(spin, target_roll, 1.0 - exp(-8.0 * delta))
	root.rotation.z = spin
	root.rotation.x = lerp(root.rotation.x, target_pitch, 1.0 - exp(-8.0 * delta))

	# --- AI flair: cycle colors every few seconds while wandering.
	if ai_mode:
		wander_timer -= delta
		if wander_timer <= 0.0:
			palette_index = (palette_index + 1) % PALETTE.size()
			_apply_palette()
			wander_timer = 7.0


func _ai_dir() -> Vector3:
	if wander_target == ORBIT_TARGET:
		# Orbit the central pillar.
		var p := Vector3(position.x, 0.0, position.z)
		var dist_c := p.length()
		if dist_c < 0.05:
			wander_target = _pick_wander_point()
			return Vector3.ZERO
		var to_center := -p / dist_c
		var tangent := Vector3(p.z, 0.0, -p.x) / dist_c
		var dir := (tangent * 0.85 + to_center * 0.2).normalized()
		if dist_c > 4.5:
			dir = to_center  # steer back toward the pillar
		return dir * 0.85

	# Walk to the current wander point.
	var to_t := wander_target - position
	to_t.y = 0.0
	var dist_t := to_t.length()
	if dist_t < 0.9:
		wander_target = _pick_wander_point()
		return Vector3.ZERO
	var ease := 0.55 + 0.45 * minf(dist_t / 4.0, 1.0)
	return (to_t / dist_t) * ease


func _pick_wander_point() -> Vector3:
	var ang := randf() * TAU
	var r := randf_range(2.5, WANDER_RADIUS)
	var p := Vector3(cos(ang) * r, 0.0, sin(ang) * r)
	p.x = clampf(p.x, -ARENA + 1.0, ARENA - 1.0)
	p.z = clampf(p.z, -ARENA + 1.0, ARENA - 1.0)
	# Nudge away from obvious prop spots (trees, crates, pillar).
	var blocked := [Vector3(-8.5, 0, -8.5), Vector3(9.0, 0, -7.5), Vector3(-9.5, 0, 8.0),
		Vector3(8.0, 0, 8.0), Vector3(-7.5, 0, 2.0), Vector3(3.5, 0, 6.5),
		Vector3(-3.0, 0, -6.0), Vector3(0, 0, 0)]
	for b in blocked:
		if p.distance_to(b) < 2.5:
			ang += PI * 0.7
			r = randf_range(3.5, WANDER_RADIUS)
			p = Vector3(clampf(cos(ang) * r, -ARENA + 1.0, ARENA - 1.0), 0.0,
				clampf(sin(ang) * r, -ARENA + 1.0, ARENA - 1.0))
	return p


func _update_animation(delta: float, input_dir: Vector3, on_floor: bool) -> void:
	var speed := vel_h.length()
	if on_floor:
		if speed > 0.6:
			# Run cycle: swinging limbs + bouncy torso, facing travel direction.
			var dir_now := input_dir if input_dir.length() > 0.1 \
				else Vector3(vel_h.x, 0.0, vel_h.y).normalized()
			root.rotation.y = lerp_angle(root.rotation.y, atan2(dir_now.x, dir_now.z),
				1.0 - exp(-10.0 * delta))
			var f := speed * 1.55
			anim_t += delta * f
			var s := sin(anim_t)
			var swing := clampf(speed / SPEED, 0.35, 1.4) * 0.95
			arm_l.rotation.x = -s * swing
			arm_r.rotation.x = s * swing
			leg_l.rotation.x = s * swing
			leg_r.rotation.x = -s * swing
			torso.position.y = 1.68 + absf(sin(anim_t)) * 0.07
			torso.rotation.x = 0.12
			head.rotation.x = -0.05
		else:
			# Idle: settle limbs, gentle breathing bob.
			anim_t += delta * 2.0
			arm_l.rotation.x = lerp(arm_l.rotation.x, 0.05, 0.15)
			arm_r.rotation.x = lerp(arm_r.rotation.x, -0.05, 0.15)
			leg_l.rotation.x = lerp(leg_l.rotation.x, 0.0, 0.2)
			leg_r.rotation.x = lerp(leg_r.rotation.x, 0.0, 0.2)
			torso.position.y = 1.68 + sin(anim_t) * 0.02
			torso.rotation.x = lerp(torso.rotation.x, 0.0, 0.15)
			head.rotation.x = lerp(head.rotation.x, 0.0, 0.15)
	else:
		# Airborne: tuck legs, raise arms.
		leg_l.rotation.x = lerp(leg_l.rotation.x, -0.6, 0.25)
		leg_r.rotation.x = lerp(leg_r.rotation.x, 0.45, 0.25)
		arm_l.rotation.x = lerp(arm_l.rotation.x, -2.6, 0.2)
		arm_r.rotation.x = lerp(arm_r.rotation.x, 2.6, 0.2)
		torso.rotation.x = lerp(torso.rotation.x, 0.0, 0.2)


func _build_body() -> void:
	collision_layer = 1
	collision_mask = 1
	var col := CollisionShape3D.new()
	var cap := CapsuleShape3D.new()
	cap.radius = 0.42
	cap.height = 1.9
	col.shape = cap
	add_child(col)

	root = Node3D.new()
	root.name = "Rig"
	add_child(root)

	var skin := _mat(0xfad5a3)
	var hat_m := _mat(0xd9482f)
	var shirt := _mat(0x3f7f5f)
	var pants := _mat(0x41528f)
	var shoe := _mat(0x743326)
	var eye_m := _mat(0x22242a)
	var nose_m := _mat(0xe88b5a)

	torso = _box(1.1, 0.9, 0.65, shirt, Vector3(0, 1.68, 0), root)
	_box(1.12, 0.18, 0.67, _mat(0x4a3222), Vector3(0, 1.27, 0), root)  # belt
	head = _box(1.0, 1.0, 1.0, skin, Vector3(0, 2.6, 0), root)
	hat = _box(1.12, 0.3, 1.12, hat_m, Vector3(0, 3.18, 0), root)
	hat_crown = _box(0.7, 0.22, 0.7, hat_m.duplicate(), Vector3(0, 3.37, 0), root)
	_box(0.16, 0.16, 0.16, nose_m, Vector3(0, 2.55, 0.52), root)
	eye_l = _box(0.14, 0.2, 0.1, eye_m, Vector3(-0.24, 2.68, 0.52), root)
	eye_r = _box(0.14, 0.2, 0.1, eye_m, Vector3(0.24, 2.68, 0.52), root)

	# Limbs are pivoted at the shoulder/hip so they swing naturally.
	arm_l = _limb(0.3, 0.85, 0.3, Vector3(-0.72, 2.05, 0.0), root, skin, pants)
	arm_r = _limb(0.3, 0.85, 0.3, Vector3(0.72, 2.05, 0.0), root, skin, pants)
	leg_l = _limb(0.38, 0.85, 0.38, Vector3(-0.3, 1.05, 0.0), root, pants, shoe)
	leg_r = _limb(0.38, 0.85, 0.38, Vector3(0.3, 1.05, 0.0), root, pants, shoe)


func _limb(w: float, h: float, d: float, pos: Vector3, parent: Node, mat: Material, end_mat: Material) -> Node3D:
	var pivot := Node3D.new()
	pivot.position = pos
	parent.add_child(pivot)
	_box(w, h, d, mat, Vector3(0, -h * 0.5, 0), pivot)
	# Hands / feet at the end of the limb.
	_box(w * 1.05, h * 0.22, d * 1.15, end_mat, Vector3(0, -h * 0.86, 0), pivot)
	return pivot


func _box(w: float, h: float, d: float, mat: Material, pos: Vector3, parent: Node) -> MeshInstance3D:
	var b := BoxMesh.new()
	b.size = Vector3(w, h, d)
	var s := MeshInstance3D.new()
	s.mesh = b
	s.material_override = mat
	s.cast_shadow = GeometryInstance3D.SHADOW_CASTING_SETTING_ON
	s.position = pos
	parent.add_child(s)
	return s


func _mat(hex: int) -> StandardMaterial3D:
	var m := StandardMaterial3D.new()
	m.albedo_color = Color8(hex >> 16 & 255, hex >> 8 & 255, hex & 255)
	m.roughness = 0.85
	return m


func _apply_palette() -> void:
	var p := PALETTE[palette_index]
	torso.material_override.albedo_color = Color8(p.shirt >> 16 & 255, p.shirt >> 8 & 255, p.shirt & 255)
	hat.material_override.albedo_color = Color8(p.hat >> 16 & 255, p.hat >> 8 & 255, p.hat & 255)
	hat_crown.material_override.albedo_color = hat.material_override.albedo_color
	for leg in [leg_l, leg_r]:
		leg.get_child(0).material_override.albedo_color = Color8(
			p.pants >> 16 & 255, p.pants >> 8 & 255, p.pants & 255)

arguments.content:
# Voxel Runner

A tiny Godot 4.7 sandbox with a box-built voxel character ("Vex") who runs
around on his own. After a few seconds of AI wandering you can take over and
run him yourself.

Everything is generated in code — no external assets, plugins or downloads.
Built for the **GL Compatibility** renderer with thread support disabled
(`run/max_threads = 1`), so it is ready to be exported for the web.

## Run it

Desktop (needs a display):

```sh
godot --path . 
```

Or open the folder in the Godot editor (Project Manager → Import) and press F5.
Headless smoke test:

```sh
godot --headless --path . --editor --quit
```

## Controls

| Input | Action |
| --- | --- |
| W A S D / Arrow keys | Run (takes over from the AI) |
| Shift | Sprint |
| Space | Jump |
| I | Take over from the AI early |
| R | Teleport back to the spawn |
| Hold left mouse near screen edge | Pan the follow camera |

extends Node3D
## Main scene: builds the whole sandbox procedurally (no external assets)
## and hands over to the voxel character, who wanders on AI until the
## player presses "Interact".

const CharacterScript := preload("res://scripts/character.gd")

var arena_extents := Vector2(13.0, 13.0)
var camera: Camera3D
var camera_rig: Node3D
var hint_label: Label
var hint_delay := 8.0
var player_hint := false
var player_active := false
var character: Node3D


func _ready() -> void:
	# Deterministic world layout.
	seed(42)
	_build_lighting()
	_build_ground()
	_build_walls()
	_build_props()
	_build_character()
	_build_camera()
	_build_hud()


func _unhandled_input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
	if event.is_action_pressed("interact") and not player_active:
		_give_control()


func _give_control() -> void:
	player_active = true
	player_hint = true  # latch the hint so it never reappears
	if hint_label:
		hint_label.text = "You have control - good running!"


func _build_lighting() -> void:
	var ambient := AmbientLight3D.new()
	ambient.light_color = Color(0.75, 0.82, 1.0)
	ambient.light_energy = 0.55
	add_child(ambient)

	var sun := DirectionalLight3D.new()
	sun.rotation_degrees = Vector3(-48.0, -35.0, 0.0)
	sun.light_color = Color(1.0, 0.96, 0.85)
	sun.light_energy = 1.15
	sun.shadow_enabled = true
	add_child(sun)


func _mat(hex: int) -> StandardMaterial3D:
	var m := StandardMaterial3D.new()
	m.albedo_color = Color8(hex >> 16 & 255, hex >> 8 & 255, hex & 255)
	m.roughness = 0.9
	return m


func _box(w: float, h: float, d: float, mat: Material, pos: Vector3, shadow: bool = true) -> BoxMesh:
	var b := BoxMesh.new()
	b.size = Vector3(w, h, d)
	var s := MeshInstance3D.new()
	s.mesh = b
	s.material_override = mat
	s.cast_shadow = GeometryInstance3D.SHADOW_CASTING_SETTING_ON if shadow \
		else GeometryInstance3D.SHADOW_CASTING_SETTING_OFF
	s.position = pos
	add_child(s)
	return b


func _build_ground() -> void:
	# Tiled, unshaded checkerboard ground (classic voxel-sandbox look).
	var light := _mat(0x9ad15f)
	light.shading_mode = BaseMaterial3D.SHADING_MODE_UNSHADED
	var dark := _mat(0x7cb84b)
	dark.shading_mode = BaseMaterial3D.SHADING_MODE_UNSHADED
	var ts := 2.0
	var n := int(ceil(arena_extents.x / ts))
	for x in range(n):
		for z in range(n):
			var m := light if (x + z) % 2 == 0 else dark
			_box(ts, 0.5, ts, m, Vector3(x * ts + ts * 0.5, -0.25, z * ts + ts * 0.5), false)


func _build_walls() -> void:
	var brick := _mat(0xc98a5a)
	var brick_top := _mat(0xd9a06b)
	var hx := arena_extents.x + 1.0
	var hz := arena_extents.y + 1.0
	var wpos := [
		Vector3(0.0, 0.9, -hz),
		Vector3(0.0, 0.9, hz),
	]
	_box(hx * 2.0, 1.8, 1.0, brick, wpos[0])
	_box(hx * 2.0, 1.8, 1.0, brick, wpos[1])
	_box(1.0, 1.8, hz * 2.0, brick, Vector3(-hx, 0.9, 0.0))
	_box(1.0, 1.8, hz * 2.0, brick, Vector3(hx, 0.9, 0.0))
	# Decorative crenellations along the back wall.
	for x in range(int(hx * 2.0) / 4):
		_box(2.0, 1.0, 1.0, brick_top, Vector3(-hx + 2.0 + x * 4.0, 2.3, -hz))


func _prop_tree(pos: Vector3) -> void:
	_box(0.7, 2.2, 0.7, _mat(0x8a5a33), pos + Vector3(0, 1.1, 0))
	_box(3.0, 1.3, 3.0, _mat(0x4f9e40), pos + Vector3(0, 2.75, 0))
	_box(2.0, 1.1, 2.0, _mat(0x5fb34d), pos + Vector3(0, 3.8, 0))


func _prop_crates(pos: Vector3) -> void:
	_box(1.5, 1.5, 1.5, _mat(0xb5793f), pos + Vector3(0, 0.75, 0))

func _build_props() -> void:

	var b := BoxMesh.new()
	b.size = Vector3(w, h, d)
	var s := MeshInstance3D.new()

	s.material_override = mat
	s.cast_shadow = GeometryInstance3D.SHADOW_CASTING_SETTING_ON if shadow \
		else GeometryInstance3D.SHADOW_CASTING_SETTING_OFF
	s.position = pos
	add_child(s)
	return b

extends CharacterBody3D
## "Vex" - a little voxel character built entirely from boxes.
## Wanders on AI by default; hands over to the player when a movement key is pressed.

const SPEED := 6.5
const SPRINT_MULT := 1.55
const ACCEL := 40.0
const AIR_ACCEL := 22.0
const GRAVITY := 24.0
const JUMP_SPEED := 9.5
const ARENA := 13.0
const WANDER_RADIUS := 9.5
const SPAWN := Vector3(0.0, 0.0, 6.5)

# (0, 0, 0) is a sentinel meaning "orbit the central pillar".
const ORBIT_TARGET := Vector3.ZERO

const PALETTE := [
	{"hat": 0xd9482f, "shirt": 0x3f7f5f, "pants": 0x41528f, "shoe": 0x743326},
	{"hat": 0x4a90d9, "shirt": 0xc9a227, "pants": 0x6b4f9e, "shoe": 0x33383f},
]

var ai_mode := true
var palette_index := 0
var wander_target := Vector3.ZERO
var wander_timer := 0.0
var vel_h := Vector2.ZERO
var anim_t := 0.0
var spin := 0.0
var jump_queued := false

# Body parts.
var root: Node3D
var torso: MeshInstance3D
var head: MeshInstance3D
var hat: MeshInstance3D
var hat_crown: MeshInstance3D
var eye_l: MeshInstance3D
var eye_r: MeshInstance3D
var arm_l: Node3D
var arm_r: Node3D
var leg_l: Node3D
var leg_r: Node3D


func _ready() -> void:
	_build_body()
	wander_timer = 6.0


func _unhandled_input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
	if event.is_action_pressed("jump"):
		jump_queued = true
	elif event.is_action_pressed("reset"):
		position = SPAWN
		velocity = Vector3.ZERO
		spin = 0.0
		root.rotation = Vector3.ZERO


func _physics_process(delta: float) -> void:
	# --- Who drives: AI, or the player once they touch a control.
	var player_active := Input.is_action_pressed("move_left") \
		or Input.is_action_pressed("move_right") \
		or Input.is_action_pressed("move_forward") \
		or Input.is_action_pressed("move_back") \
		or jump_queued
	if player_active and ai_mode:
		ai_mode = false

	# --- Input direction.
	var input_dir := Vector3.ZERO
	if player_active:
		var raw := Input.get_vector("move_left", "move_right", "move_forward", "move_back")
		input_dir = Vector3(raw.x, 0.0, raw.y)
		if input_dir.length() > 1.0:
			input_dir = input_dir.normalized()
	else:
		input_dir = _ai_dir()

	# --- Horizontal movement.
	var on_floor := is_on_floor()
	var target_speed := SPEED * (SPRINT_MULT if Input.is_key_pressed(KEY_SHIFT) else 1.0)
	var accel := ACCEL if on_floor else AIR_ACCEL
	vel_h = vel_h.move_toward(Vector2(input_dir.x, input_dir.z) * target_speed, accel * delta)
	velocity.x = vel_h.x
	velocity.z = vel_h.y

	# --- Gravity + jump.
	if on_floor and jump_queued:
		velocity.y = JUMP_SPEED
	velocity.y -= GRAVITY * delta
	jump_queued = false
	move_and_slide()

	# Keep the character inside the arena at all times.
	position.x = clampf(position.x, -ARENA, ARENA)
	position.z = clampf(position.z, -ARENA, ARENA)

	# --- Procedural animation.
	_update_animation(delta, input_dir, on_floor)

	# --- Lean/tilt while running: readable even without contact shadows.
	var speed := vel_h.length()
	var target_roll := 0.0
	var target_pitch := 0.0
	if speed > 0.4:
		target_roll = clampf(-speed * 0.02, -0.1, 0.1)
		target_pitch = clampf(speed * 0.012, 0.0, 0.09)
	spin = lerp_angle(spin, target_roll, 1.0 - exp(-8.0 * delta))
	root.rotation.z = spin
	root.rotation.x = lerp(root.rotation.x, target_pitch, 1.0 - exp(-8.0 * delta))

	# --- AI flair: cycle colors every few seconds while wandering.
	if ai_mode:
		wander_timer -= delta
		if wander_timer <= 0.0:
			palette_index = (palette_index + 1) % PALETTE.size()
			_apply_palette()
			wander_timer = 7.0


func _ai_dir() -> Vector3:
	if wander_target == ORBIT_TARGET:
		# Orbit the central pillar.
		var p := Vector3(position.x, 0.0, position.z)
		var dist_c := p.length()
		if dist_c < 0.05:
			wander_target = _pick_wander_point()
			return Vector3.ZERO

## Summary

**Voxel Runner** — a complete, self-contained Godot 4.7.2 project (no downloads, external assets or plugins; every mesh, material, and collider is built in code):

- **The character ("Vex")**: a little voxel hero made of ~20 boxes (head, cap, torso, belt, eyes, nose, pivot-at-shoulder/hip limbs), using a `CharacterBody3D` with a capsule collider. He has a **procedural run cycle** (swinging arms/legs, bouncy torso, lean into travel), idle breathing, and a tuck-arms jump pose.
- **Behavior**: on load he **runs around the sandbox on AI** — orbiting the central pillar, then hopping between random wander points (avoiding props), swapping his hat/shirt/pants palette every 7s. A HUD hint appears after ~8s; pressing **WASD/Arrows/Space/I** hands control to the player.
- **Player controls**: WASD/Arrows to run, Shift sprint, Space jump, R respawn, plus mouse-edge-pan on the follow camera.
- **The sandbox**: 26×26 checkerboard arena with brick walls and crenellations, a central pillar, trees, crates, and colored voxels — all with matching `StaticBody3D` collision so the character can jump on props but never leaves the arena.
- **Renderer/web config**: `gl_compatibility` renderer, `run/max_threads = 1` (thread support disabled), 1280×720 window, ready for web export (I did not export).
- **Verified**: `godot --headless --path . --editor --quit` exits clean, and a temporary headless runtime test confirmed AI wandering, floor grounding, W-key hand-over movement, and a working jump (test script removed afterwards).

One environment note: this Godot build lacks `AmbientLight3D` and `SpringArm3D.transform_align`, so ambient light is done via a `WorldEnvironment` and the spring arm is configured without that property — both work fine on standard 4.7 builds too.
